purpose: Reusable foliage textures used in the illustrated simulator

prompts.broadleaf-painted-v1.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: one seamless square hand-painted broadleaf tree foliage ALBEDO texture for simple organic 3D crown lobes in a premium cozy isometric park-building game. Fill the entire square edge to edge with softly interlocking irregular rounded foliage masses. Medium-large simplified layered gouache brush shapes, warm pastel green and muted turquoise green, small yellow-green highlights, a few restrained darker green painted pockets. Gentle tonal richness and organic rounded overlapping brushwork, charming storybook game art. Simplified foliage masses rather than individually detailed leaves. Even diffuse illumination; no strong baked directional lighting because the 3D scene supplies unified sun lighting. Flat orthographic texture swatch, no perspective, no whole tree, no trunk, no sky, no ground, no framing, no text, no labels, no UI, no photorealism, no low-poly facets, no perfect circles, no neon. Seamlessly repeatable on both axes. Subtle contrast so texture remains clean at medium and distant zoom. Opaque image, square.
prompts.conifer-painted-v1.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless square opaque texture swatch for hand-painted soft evergreen foliage in a cozy storybook isometric park game. This is an albedo texture to wrap around rounded 3D spruce branch tiers, not a tree illustration. All over edge-to-edge broad overlapping drooping scalloped brush masses, soft muted sage and turquoise-green palette, gentle moss-green highlights and restrained desaturated darker painted pockets, simplified gouache, soft natural pastel values. Much simpler than individual needles: only broad elegant layered brush shapes readable from distance, no tiny noisy detail. Even neutral illumination, no baked directional shadow, no trunk, no whole trees, no perspective, no scenery, no background border, no text, no logo, no neon, no sharp cones, no realistic needles. Flat texture sheet seamless horizontally and vertically, low contrast.
